verdict: BigCommerce: Choose BigCommerce when you want a Shopify-class hosted platform with open architecture and multi-storefront headroom — and you will model GMV thresholds and payment fees explicitly. Scores use the Ecommerce editorial methodology from first-party research as of 2026-08-17 — not hands-on product testing.
strengths: Strong SaaS catalog/order depth without Shopify transaction fee on platform
Multi-storefront and B2B features on higher tiers
weaknesses: 2026 GMV/OPP fee changes require careful TCO modeling
Omnichannel POS is not the core story
bestFor: Growing catalog brands comparing open-SaaS TCO to Shopify
Merchants needing multi-storefront or B2B on one platform
Teams with dev resources for API/headless experiments
notIdealFor: Retail-first merchants needing best-in-class POS bundle
Buyers who want the largest theme marketplace on day one
tradeoffs: Subscription floors vs payment-processing spreads and GMV/overage fees
App/extension TCO vs native feature depth
Open-source/hosting flexibility vs SaaS operational simplicity
Dropshipping product caps vs catalog automation depth
recommendation: Choose BigCommerce when you want a Shopify-class hosted platform with open architecture and multi-storefront headroom — and you will model GMV thresholds and payment fees explicitly. Consider Shopify for ecosystem/POS depth; WooCommerce for open-source control; Square Online for retail-led omnichannel.
